candidates.summary: Republican Representative Virginia Foxx conceded North Carolina’s 5th Congressional District race to Democrat Chuck Hubbard on November 22 following a recount. The Associated Press called the race for Hubbard on Sunday. Unofficial state results showed Hubbard ahead by 330 votes out of roughly 287,000 cast; certification remained pending. The projection brought Democrats to at least 258 House seats, their largest total following a general election since 1992.
candidates.title: Foxx concedes North Carolina House race to Hubbard after recount

candidates.summary: COP31 closed in Antalya on November 22 without consensus on an overarching climate agreement after the European Union and other delegations rejected the proposed outcome. Disagreements included fossil-fuel transition language and climate finance. In his closing remarks, UN climate chief Simon Stiell confirmed that the conference could not agree on the presidency-led decisions, while noting that separate negotiating decisions, including on a just transition, had been made. The failure of the overarching agreement did not mean that all conference decisions failed.
candidates.title: COP31 closes without overarching agreement but adopts separate negotiating decisions

sources.name: UN Framework Convention on Climate Change
